name: tensor_pipe_forms
extends: tools/microbench/tensor_pipe/protocol-v2.json (b300): the same two quantities with the same definitions, at the tensor.pipe points protocol-v2 did not measure
scope: b300 only. The b300 tensor.pipe table (blackwell/leaves/tensor.pipe.json, 9210 points, partition operation_class / umma_kind / cta_group / a_src, discrete over [tensor_m, tensor_n, tensor_k, umma_operation, umma_operand_major, umma_max_shift]) was measured by tensor_pipe v2 only at umma_operation normal, M = 128 per CTA, major 0, max shift 0 (1143 points). The other 8067 points hold the blackwell-prototype umma full-form single-op latency as pipe cycles with tensor.completion = 0 (source tensor_pipe.structural.completion_unmeasured_points): ws / sp / ws_sp operations, M 32 / 64 per CTA (M 64 / 128 at cta_group 2), operand majors 1-3 and max shifts 1-3. h100 and the b300 normal / M 128 / major 0 / shift 0 points are another line's and are not installed by this protocol (they are re-measured as a control only).
probe: tools/microbench/tensor_pipe_forms/probe/umma_factors.cu + umma_factor_impl.cuh + umma_factor_forms.hpp (generated): blackwell-prototype tools/microbench/probes/umma_factors.cu, umma_factor_impl.cuh, probes/umma_factor_forms.hpp verbatim (the k_factor kernels with ELECTED = 1: whole issuer warp enters the warp-uniform branch and elect.sync picks the issuing lane, the form blackwell-prototype round 8 introduced because the lane == 0 form made ptxas wrap every UMMA in a wave-serialisation loop) with these changes only: (1) append_form emits xw U in {0, 1} and cad U in {32, 64, 128} (the predecessor's cad 8 / 16 / 256 are dropped); (2) the generator (gen_umma_full_forms.py + gen_umma_factor_forms.py + umma_factor_encode.py + umma_full_domain.py/.json, copied verbatim) gains batch `forms`: every shape row of the PTX full domain (expand(): kind x operation x cta_group x M x N x K x a_src, majors and max shifts per row, sm_103a restrictions of umma_full_domain.json) with elected = 1, base form (major 0, shift 0) plus one form per non-zero major and per non-zero max shift; rows the domain marks unmeasurable (ws M 32 max shift 3: illegal instruction, blackwell-prototype known gap) keep run_status unmeasurable and are not launched; mx-kind sparse rows the predecessor could not lay out (TMEM column overlap, second-batch skip reason) stay unmeasurable; (3) one binary per kind (UMMA_FACTOR_KIND_FILTER) with both cta_groups, ws and sparse included. Launch config: cluster of cta_group CTAs x 128 threads, --launches 8 --reps 129, two runs (run-a, run-b) in one job per binary.
sass_gate: per k_factor kernel instantiation (name decoded from the template arguments: KIND, CG, ASRC, MODE, U, M_ROWS, WS, SPARSE, ELECTED): the CS2R window holds exactly U UTC{H,Q,O}MMA of the kind's class (HMMA f16 / tf32, QMMA f8f6f4 / mxf8f6f4, OMMA mxf4 / mxf4nvf4), .2CTA iff CG = 2, .SP iff SPARSE, .WS iff WS (opcode modifiers as printed by cuobjdump); between the first and the last UMMA no BRA.U.ANY and no ELECT (the wave-serialisation loop); the xw U = 1 kernel holds one UMMA and the xw U = 0 kernel none; o_s from the control words as in tensor_pipe v2 model.py o_s_and_gate. A form whose kernels fail the gate is unrealised. 0 kernels matched = gate failure of the binary.
functional_check: the probe's own D check (one launch per form, D == sign x K x MMAs; d_ok) and the timed-run check (d_timed_ok for xw U = 1) must both be true, else the form is unrealised (predecessor rule)

derivation.E_U, o_s: as tensor_pipe v2 (median over launches x reps of the cad window t1 - t0 per U; xw: t_w - t_s)
derivation.beat: OLS slope of E_U(cad) over U in {32, 64, 128}
derivation.latency_1: (E_xw1 - E_xw0) - (o_s1 - o_s0), E_xw0 from the same form's xw U = 0 kernel (same KIND / CG / ASRC / M_ROWS / WS / SPARSE)

acceptance.beat: max relative residual of the {32, 64, 128} fit <= 2 % and run agreement <= 3 % -> measured, else experimental (installed as experimental)
acceptance.completion: run agreement <= 5 % or <= 2 cycles -> measured; a negative completion within 2 se of 0 installs 0; beyond 2 se: not installed (the point keeps the predecessor pipe = single-op latency, completion 0) and listed
acceptance.control: the predecessor pipe value at the point (single-op latency) compared with latency_1: within 10 % -> confirmed; beyond -> both numbers reported; the point is replaced by beat + completion whenever its cells pass (tensor_pipe v2 b300_control rule)
acceptance.v2_points: forms at the v2-measured coordinates (normal, M 128 per CTA, major 0, shift 0) are measured as a control of this probe form against the installed v2 beat (reported per point, not installed here)

install: blackwell/leaves/tensor.pipe.json: at every passing form coordinate (tensor_m = instruction M, tensor_n, tensor_k = the row's K, umma_operation in {normal, sp, ws, ws_sp}, umma_operand_major, umma_max_shift) under the matching (class, umma_kind, cta_group, a_src) node, cycles = beat; blackwell/leaves/tensor.completion.json at the same coordinate = completion (install.py of tensor_pipe extended with a --forms mode that keys cells by the full coordinate); coordinates that fail stay as they are and are listed; the structural source tensor_pipe.structural.completion_unmeasured_points is kept for the points still at 0 and its description lists the count; source keys tensor_pipe_forms.b300.<run> (+ .experimental); artifacts $A/microbench/tensor_pipe_forms/b300-<run>/, $A/microbench/tensor_pipe_forms-model/b300-<run>/model.json; one two-architecture 450 A/B round (bw moves; hp unchanged by construction)
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold or derivation change after data; no neighbour fill (every installed point has its own passing form); no change to h100 or to the v2-installed b300 points

addenda.before_run: b300-r1 (no tensor_pipe_forms GPU run has started)
addenda.text: Scope change agreed with the tensor_pipe line (which verified the BRA.U.ANY wave-serialisation loop in the v2 umma_cadence SASS and downgraded the b300 v2 normal points to experimental, values unchanged): the forms at the v2 coordinates (normal, M 128 per CTA, major 0, shift 0) are no longer control-only -- when a point passes the acceptance it is installed too (tensor.pipe = beat, tensor.completion = completion, evidence measured, replacing the v2 value), and the per-point comparison new vs v2 is written into the report (the N <= 96 floor of v2, 44-48 cycles, is the key evidence: the elected form of blackwell-prototype round 8 gave 39-40 at N <= 32 for SMEM-A M128 and ~8-9 at N <= 16 for TMEM-A M64). SASS gate tightened per that line's request: between the first and the last target MMA of a window no BRA of any kind, no ELECT and no WARPSYNC (in addition to the count / class / modifier rules). h100 stays outside this protocol.

addenda.before_run: b300-r3 (written after the b300-r2 derivation and install, before any r3 launch)
addenda.text: (1) Re-run for the completion cells that failed in b300-r2: the 54 forms whose completion was not installable in r2 (run agreement > 5 % and > 2 cycles; 20 of them at the v2 coordinates normal / M 128 per CTA / major 0 / shift 0, which therefore still hold the tensor_pipe v2 beat) are re-measured by a full re-run b300-r3 of the same probe and binaries (no probe change). Install rule for r3, fixed here: only those 54 forms are eligible; a form is installed from r3 (beat = r3 beat, completion = r3 completion, evidence per the r2 acceptance rules applied to the r3 pair) iff its r3 beat and completion both pass the acceptance; a form that fails again is recorded unrealised (point keeps its current value; the v2 coordinate points keep the v2 beat and completion 0) and the source list of its node keeps tensor_pipe.b300.r2(.experimental). All other forms' r3 results are reported as a reproduction control of r2 (|r3 - r2| per form) and are not installed. (2) Sparse identity: cuobjdump prints no .SP modifier for sparse UTC*MMA on this toolchain, so the sass gate cannot distinguish a sparse from a dense op by text; the sparse identity of a SPARSE form is established by the probe's D check instead: d_expect = sign x K / 2 for sparse (sign x K for dense), so a sparse descriptor executed as dense fails d_ok. sass_check records sparse_check = 'probe D' for SPARSE kernels; model.py requires d_ok and d_timed_ok (already in the functional check) -- this addendum names that as the sparse gate. (3) The 408 mx-kind sparse points (mxf8f6f4 / mxf4 / mxf4nvf4 x sp / ws_sp) are recorded unrealised: the predecessor's TMEM column layout (A / SFA / SFB / sparsity metadata columns overlap for these shapes, umma_full_domain.json unmeasurable rows) gives no launchable form; they keep the predecessor single-op latency as pipe and completion 0 (structural source tensor_pipe.structural.completion_unmeasured_points). (4) Cross-class points: the b300 tensor.pipe / tensor.completion tables list every umma_kind under every UTC*MMA class; the pairs a class cannot execute are removed (pure refactor, 450 unchanged by construction): reachable pairs are UTCHMMA x {f16, tf32}, UTCQMMA x {f8f6f4, mxf8f6f4}, UTCOMMA x {mxf4, mxf4nvf4}, by the ISA (tcgen05.mma .kind::f16 / tf32 -> UTCHMMA, .kind::f8f6f4 / mxf8f6f4 -> UTCQMMA, .kind::mxf4 / mxf4nvf4 -> UTCOMMA), by the b300-r2 SASS dumps (umma_factors_<kind>_cg{1,2}.sass: every measured kernel's ops disassemble to that class only) and by the converter rule (_umma_kind_of / _umma_descriptor_facts derive umma_kind from the opcode root), so no job can carry another pair.

addenda.before_run: b300-r4 (written after the discrete fail-closed census $A/merge/dfc/discrete-miss-census.tsv and before any r4 build or launch; no r4 data exists)
addenda.text: Domain extension for the 16-bit / tf32 kinds. The generator (umma_full_domain.py add()) gave f16 and tf32 rows major_values [0] only (inherited from blackwell-prototype), so the installed tensor.pipe / tensor.completion f16 / tf32 nodes carry no point at umma_operand_major 1, 2 or 3; with the engine now failing closed on a discrete point miss (main e96cf6e) 233 of the 500 Blackwell single-cluster cases (FA3 / ML3 / CU3 / DG3 / TR3 / FI3 / BL3, census columns node 478 / 481 / 488: m128 n128 k16 major 1 x 99, m128 n256 k16 major 1 x 33, m64 n256 k16 ws major 1 x 26, m256 n128 k16 major 1 x 17, m256 n256 k16 major 2 x 12, ...) are rejected with unsupported:engine:discrete_miss. Rule, fixed here: (1) f16 and tf32 rows take the same major_values rule as f8f6f4 (major_values [0, 1, 2, 3] when B may be MN-major -- N >= 16 (cta_group 1) / 32 (cta_group 2) and N a multiple of it -- else [0, 2]; a_src tmem rows [0, 1] under the same N condition else [0]); the base form (major 0, shift 0) is re-measured as the control. (2) Forms the hardware rejects (illegal instruction / launch failure, as the ws M 32 max-shift-3 rows) are recorded run_status unmeasurable and the coordinate stays absent (the engine keeps rejecting such jobs; if a rejected coordinate is one the census needs, that is reported, not patched). (3) Build only the f16 and tf32 binaries (UMMA_FACTOR_KIND_FILTER), two runs (run-a, run-b), same launch config, same SASS gate, same beat / completion acceptance and the same control rule as the protocol body; install only the new coordinates (majors 1-3) with install.py --only-forms, source key tensor_pipe_forms.b300.r4 (+ .experimental); the major-0 re-measurement is reported per point against the installed r2 / r3 values and not installed. (4) No value is copied across majors or kinds: a major-1/2/3 coordinate whose cells fail acceptance stays absent and its cases stay rejected.
addenda.not_allowed: no major-0 value reused for another major; no f8f6f4 value reused for f16 / tf32; no acceptance change after data

addenda.before_run: b300-r5 (written after the r4 install and the ctl-main11 census of the 11 still-rejected cases, before any r5 build or launch)
addenda.text: (1) f16 B-MN domain: the r4 rule took the f8-family restriction 'B MN-major only for N >= 16 (cta_group 1) / 32 (cta_group 2), N a multiple of it' (PTX Table 63) for f16 / tf32 as well, so f16 rows with N < 16 (cta_group 1) got major_values [0, 2]; the hardware runs FI3-GQA-DEC / GQA-PAGED (5 cases) with f16 M128 N8 K16 major 3, i.e. the restriction does not apply to 16-bit B. Rule: f16 and tf32 rows get major_values [0, 1, 2, 3] for every N and a_src smem ([0, 1] for a_src tmem) regardless of N; rows the hardware rejects are recorded unmeasurable (as before). r5 builds f16 and tf32 only and installs, with install.py --only-forms, exactly the coordinates absent after r4 (new majors at N < 16 / N < 32); every other form is a control reported against r4 / r2 / r3 and not installed. (2) tf32 MN-major: all 459 tf32 major 1-3 forms of r4 failed the functional D check (d_ok false, SASS gate ok), so the probe's operand layout for MN-major tf32 is wrong or the hardware ignores the transpose bits for 32-bit operands; r5 does not change the probe -- the D-check result of the tf32 forms is recorded per form together with the D value the probe computed and the expected value, as evidence for a later probe fix. tf32 major 1-3 points stay absent; the 6 BL3 cases needing tf32 m256 n256 k8 major 2 / 3 stay rejected until a probe form passes the D check.
addenda.not_allowed: no value copied across N, majors or kinds; no D-check relaxation; acceptance unchanged

addenda.before_run: b300-r6 (written after the r5 D-check evidence and the full-GPU 500 attribution; before any r6 generator change, build or launch)
addenda.text: (1) Root cause of the r4 / r5 tf32 MN-major D-check failures (structural evidence, not measurement): every MN-major tf32 operand was encoded with SMEM layout type SWIZZLE_128B (2, lbo 16 B / sbo 1024 B from canonical_lbo_sbo), the K-major SW128 canonical form. CUTLASS (cutlass/gemm/collective/builders/sm100_common.inl: 'for mn-major tf32 operands, SW128_32B is the only available smem layout'; cute/atom/mma_traits_sm100.hpp UMMA::Layout_MN_SW128_32B_Atom = Swizzle<2,5,2> over Shape<_1024 bits,_4>, LayoutType::SWIZZLE_128B_BASE32B = 1) accepts exactly one MN-major layout for 32-bit operands: a 512 B atom of 32 elements (128 B) x 4 K-rows, canonical ((T,8,m),(4,k)):((1,T,LBO),(8T,SBO)) with LBO = MN-atom stride and SBO = K-group (4-row) stride. The hardware read the SW128-typed MN-major tf32 views as zeros (d_first 0, d_expect 8, timings produced), so the forms ran but computed nothing. The predecessor's only SW128_32B_ATOM smoke (gen_umma_factor_forms.py: 'C1 returned 0 for expected 16') was an f16 form (K = 16), for which BASE32B is invalid, so BASE32B was never tested on tf32. (2) Rule for r6, fixed here: the swizzle is chosen per operand. An MN-major tf32 operand (A when idesc bit 15 is set, B when bit 16 is set) uses layout type SWIZZLE_128B_BASE32B with LBO = 512 B (MN-atom stride, atoms packed first) and SBO = 512 B x rows / 32 (K-group stride, rows = the operand's M or N per CTA: M / cta_group for A, N / cta_group for B), start 0, base_offset 0, lbo_mode relative; the data regions stay the all-ones fill (span for M or N <= 256 and K = 8 is <= 8 KiB, inside the 52 KiB A / B regions). Every K-major operand and every f16 form keeps SW128 / 16 / 1024 exactly as in r2-r5 (byte-identical descriptors, verified by diffing the generated tf32 forms whose transpose is (K, K) against the r5 gen json). Generator changes allowed: make_config computes (lbo, sbo, swizzle) per operand; canonical_lbo_sbo('SW128_32B_ATOM', 'MN') returns (512, 512 * rows // 32); the blanket 'SW128_32B_ATOM -> unmeasurable' rule of the factor generator does not apply to tf32 MN-major operands. Nothing else in the probe, the SASS gate, the derivation or the acceptance changes. (3) r6 builds the tf32 binaries only (cg1, cg2), two runs (run-a, run-b), --launches 8 --reps 129 as before. The functional D check is mandatory and unrelaxed: a tf32 MN-major form installs only if d_ok and d_timed_ok hold in both runs; a form that still fails D is recorded unmeasurable with its D values and stays absent. With D passing, beat and completion follow the protocol body acceptance (beat OLS residual <= 2 % and run agreement <= 3 %; completion run agreement <= 5 % or <= 2 cycles; measured / experimental / unrealised accordingly). Install with install.py --only-forms exactly the tf32 umma_operand_major 1 / 2 / 3 coordinates that are absent from the b300 tensor.pipe / tensor.completion tables today (the 675 r5 tf32 major != 0 forms); source key tensor_pipe_forms.b300.r6 (+ .experimental). The tf32 major-0 forms of r6 are a reproduction control reported per point against the installed r2 / r3 / r4 values (|r6 - installed| / installed, flagged above 10 %) and are not installed. (4) After install: cyclescope tree build && cyclescope tree validate --strict five classes 0; the 6 BLF tf32 cases must leave discrete_miss; single-cluster 500 x 2 A/B against the current treatment arm (facts $A/merge/cbk) and the full-GPU subset of tf32 cases.
addenda.not_allowed: no value copied across majors, kinds or swizzles; no D-check relaxation; no acceptance change after data; no change to K-major or f16 descriptors
